title: Amazon Connect Talent is now generally available
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Amazon Connect Talent is now generally available
body_markdown:
Amazon Connect Talent is now generally available, giving talent acquisition leaders an AI-powered hiring solution that accelerates candidate selection at scale. Informed by decades of Amazon's hiring science, Amazon Connect Talent uses AI agents to conduct structured voice interviews, administer evidence based assessments, and score candidates consistently, freeing recruiters to focus on strategic decisions. Candidates interview 24/7 from any device. Recruiters review scores, transcripts, and detailed candidate evaluations generated by their AI teammate, empowering them to make faster hiring decisions with consistent objectivity.


GA capabilities include competency based assessments, AI-led voice interviews with adaptive questioning, a brand-customizable mobile-first candidate portal, and system admin onboarding tools for easy deployment. Amazon Connect Talent scales to handle hiring surges, evaluating hundreds of candidates simultaneously. Amazon Connect Talent is now available in AWS US East (N. Virginia) and US West (Oregon) regions. To learn more, visit the[Amazon Connect Talent page](https://aws.amazon.com/products/connect/talent/) .
